DOCGEN.DESCRIPTION: This command creates map to associates set of PFC Priorities to Queues. This map is used to classify a queue for data packets on the basis of the received packets DOT1P field.
DOCGEN.USAGE: Use this command to create PFC Priority to Queue entires map.

EXAMPLE.summary: The following command creates DOT1P to queue entrie map.

DOCGEN.EXAMPLE: sonic# configure terminal sonic(config)#qos map pfc-priority-queue pfc-priority-queue-map

DOCGEN.DESCRIPTION: This command delete PFC Priority to queue entires map.
DOCGEN.USAGE: Use this command to delete PFC Priority to queue entries map.

EXAMPLE.summary: The following command delete PFC Priority to queue entries map

DOCGEN.EXAMPLE: sonic# configure terminal sonic(config)# no qos map pfc-priority-queue pfc-priority-queue-map

PARAM.name: dot1p_list
PARAM.help: (-) or (,) separated individual PFC Priority and ranges of PFC Priority's; for example, 0,2-7

DOCGEN.DESCRIPTION: This command to add PFC Priority to queue entry in map.
DOCGEN.USAGE: Use this command to add entry to map PFC Priority to queue.

EXAMPLE.summary: The following command add entry to map PFC Priority to queue

DOCGEN.EXAMPLE: sonic# configure terminal sonic(config)# dot1p 1 queue 0 sonic(config)# dot1p 2 queue 0 sonic(config)# dot1p 3 queue 1

PARAM.name: dot1p_list
PARAM.help: (-) or (,) separated individual PFC Priority and ranges of PFC Priority's; for example, 0,2-7

COMMAND.name: show qos map pfc-priority-queue
COMMAND.ACTION: if test "${map_pfc_queue}" = "" ; then python3 $SONIC_CLI_ROOT/sonic_cli_qos_map.py get_openconfig_qos_maps_ext_qos_pfc_priority_maps show_qos_map_pfc_priority.j2 else python3 $SONIC_CLI_ROOT/sonic_cli_qos_map.py get_openconfig_qos_maps_ext_qos_pfc_priority_maps_pfc_priority_map ${map_pfc_queue} show_qos_map_pfc_priority.j2 fi
